text: Meeting 'Discovery call' with Sarah Johnson on 2026-06-02. Meeting 'Pilot scoping' with Sarah Johnson on 2026-07-07. Summary: The pilot was approved for three teams over 60 days starting Aug 1 with a 70% reporting‑time reduction goal, and Sarah accepted the SOC2 report. She requested a 15% discount for an annual commitment and a written confirmation of the SAML beta slated for August, which will be escalated internally. Topics: Pilot scope and timeline; Success metric (70% reporting time reduction); SOC2 report acceptance; Pricing discount request (15% annual); SAML support beta target (August); Data‑driven presentation style. Decisions: Pilot approved: 3 teams for 60 days starting Aug 1 with success metric of 70% reporting‑time reduction; SOC2 report accepted by security team. Commitments made: me will Present 15% discount request to manager (due unspecified); me will Provide written confirmation of SAML beta target for August (due unspecified). Unresolved issues: Discount approval from manager; Written SAML confirmation still pending; Final pilot agreement details to be finalized. Follow-ups: Send discount proposal to manager and report back to Sarah; Email written SAML beta timeline to Sarah; Draft and circulate pilot agreement for signature; Confirm internal resources for Aug 1 start. Decisions: Manager approved a 10% discount for the pilot.
